select , (select count(*) from kb_document_acl a where a.document_id=d.id and a.subject_type='USER') userAclCount, (select count(*) from kb_document_acl a where a.document_id=d.id and a.subject_type='ROLE') roleAclCount from kb_document d join fs_file_metadata f on f.id=d.file_id and f.deleted=0 left join sys_department dep on dep.id=d.owner_department_id left join sys_user u on u.id=d.created_by where
order by d.updated_at desc,d.id desc limit #{size} offset #{offset}

select cast(d.id as char) id,d.code,d.title,d.category,d.summary,d.tags, cast(d.owner_department_id as char) ownerDepartmentId,dep.name ownerDepartment, d.visibility,d.status,d.current_version currentVersion, cast(d.file_id as char) fileId,f.original_name fileName,f.content_type contentType,f.size_bytes sizeBytes, d.effective_from effectiveFrom,d.effective_to effectiveTo, d.created_at createdAt,d.updated_at updatedAt,u.display_name createdByName from kb_document d join fs_file_metadata f on f.id=d.file_id and f.deleted=0 left join sys_department dep on dep.id=d.owner_department_id left join sys_user u on u.id=d.created_by where d.id=#{id} and d.deleted=0

select cast(v.id as char) id,v.version,cast(v.file_id as char) fileId,v.file_name fileName, v.change_note changeNote,v.created_at createdAt,u.display_name createdByName from kb_document_version v left join sys_user u on u.id=v.created_by where v.document_id=#{id} order by v.version desc
select cast(id as char) id,subject_type subjectType,subject_key subjectKey from kb_document_acl where document_id=#{id} order by subject_type,subject_key

select cast(d.id as char) id,d.title,d.category,d.current_version currentVersion,d.updated_at updatedAt from kb_document d where d.deleted=0 and d.status='PUBLISHED' and order by d.id
select cast(id as char) id,status,deleted,current_version currentVersion,updated_at updatedAt from kb_document where updated_at >= #{since,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} order by updated_at,id
